Thanks again for the productive pre-kickoff this morning. To keep momentum, here's what we need to complete the network handoff and prep the on-prem package for your infrastructure team: 

- VPN certificate bundle (private key + cert chain) or CSR if you want Redwood to sign a client cert.
- Public IP(s) for your VPN gateway and any allowed egress CIDRs.
- Shared network contact and preferred maintenance windows (we prefer 02:00–06:00 PT for BGP sessions / cert rotation).
- Any firewall rules or proxies that might terminate TLS (we'll need to validate mTLS path).

I've attached the Redwood on‑prem onboarding checklist and a blank network diagram template to this thread. If you can drop the cert bundle and a completed diagram in the Drive link below, Dev and I will run an internal acceptance plan and schedule the staging cutover.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1EmbarkOnboard

2) Redwood performs lab install and validates connectivity Thu (7/1)
3) Book 60-min staging cutover Fri (7/2) — target low-traffic window

Any questions, flag them here and we'll loop in infra.

Cheers,
